game_concept: A arcade set in Coastal Port – Tavern Terrace, a seaside tavern terrace: the fisher must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Weather Switch: Choose tools by checking weather and terrain conditions each turn.
theme: Coastal Port – Tavern Terrace: a seaside tavern terrace
core_gameplay_loop: In Tavern Terrace, repeat each round: Choose tools by checking weather and terrain conditions each turn. Each round, a new sea charts challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the gear_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 440 points of sea charts by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 440, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 7 (applied tier): Weather Switch
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Weather Switch' (Week 3 slot 7), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Tavern Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gear_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smugglers in Tavern Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 440 within 38 seconds.
